subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require an exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream fixture before accepting any recovery that can reclassify assistant text as executable tool calls?
rationale: The safe fix depends on maintainer intent for the tool-execution boundary: a narrow parser correction is straightforward after a fixture, while provider-specific text recovery can create false tool execution if the failure shape is not proven.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

options.title: Sponsor guarded recovery
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned vLLM/gpt-oss recovery design before exact reproduction, with security review and tests proving ordinary assistant JSON text is not executed.

options.title: Defer to vLLM configuration docs
options.body: Treat current tool_choice and server-template guidance as the supported workaround unless a current reproducible stream shows OpenClaw is still misparsing structured tool_calls.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent reasoning_details and post-tool-call stream work is closest to the parser behavior and safety boundary under discussion.
